gatera.en: while; on the way; taking the opportunity of

zukume.en: nothing but; entirely; one ... after another

tara-saigo-ga-saigo.en: once ... (there's no going back); if ever ..., that's the end
tara-saigo-ga-saigo.zh: 一旦……就无法挽回或停下来

te-yamanai.en: never cease to; sincerely; deeply (hope, respect, love)
te-yamanai.zh: 由衷地……、一直……，用于希望、敬爱等情感

to-aimatte.zh: 与……相结合，产生共同作用

tomo-naru-to-tomo-nareba.en: when it comes to; once (a certain level or stage) is reached
tomo-naru-to-tomo-nareba.zh: 一到……阶段或达到……程度，就……

nara-de-wa.en: unique to; that only ... could offer

beku.en: in order to; with the aim of

you-mono-nara.en: if one were to (do), (something terrible would happen)
you-mono-nara.zh: 万一做了……，就会酿成严重后果

ni-itaru-ni-itatte-ni-itatte-wa.en: reach; lead to; only when it came to; as for (the most extreme case)
ni-itaru-ni-itatte-ni-itatte-wa.zh: 发展到……、直到……才；也可引出最极端的例子

o-kinjienai.en: cannot help feeling; cannot suppress (an emotion)
o-kinjienai.zh: 不禁感到……、难以抑制某种情绪

o-yogi-naku-sareru.en: be forced to; have no choice but to

atte-no.en: (only) possible because of; owe everything to

you-ga-mai-ga-you-to-mai-to.en: whether or not; regardless of whether

you-ni-mo-nai.en: want to (do) but can't; even if one tries, one cannot

kagiri-da.zh: 感到极其……，用于强调情绪

katagata.en: while also; partly for the purpose of

ka-to-omoikiya.en: just when one thought ...; contrary to expectation

gotoki-gotoku.en: like; as; (after a person) the likes of
gotoki-gotoku.zh: 如同……、像……一样；用于人时也可表轻视

koto-tote.en: because; since (as an excuse or apology)
koto-tote.zh: 因为……，常用于解释或致歉

shimatsu-da.en: end up (in a bad state); (things) have come to this
shimatsu-da.zh: 竟落到……的地步，通常是坏结果

zu-jimai.en: end up never doing; never got around to

zu-ni-wa-okanai-nai-de-wa-okanai.en: will definitely (do); cannot fail to (cause a reaction)
zu-ni-wa-okanai-nai-de-wa-okanai.zh: 一定会……；也可表示必然引起某种反应

zu-ni-wa-sumanai-nai-de-wa-sumanai.zh: 非做……不可，不能不承担后果或责任

soba-kara.en: as soon as (and again and again)
soba-kara.zh: 刚一……就又……，常表示反复发生

taru.en: as (one in the position of); befitting

tsu-tsu.en: (doing) A and B alternately; back and forth
tsu-tsu.zh: 一会儿……一会儿……，两个动作交替

de-are-de-are-de-are.en: whatever (it is); whoever; whether A or B
de-are-de-are-de-are.zh: 无论是什么或是谁；无论是甲还是乙

te-shikaru-beki-da.en: ought to; it would only be natural to

de-wa-aru-mai-shi.en: it's not as if (one were); since (one) is not
de-wa-aru-mai-shi.zh: 又不是……，常用于反驳或劝告

temae.en: since (considering how it looks to others); out of consideration for
temae.zh: 顾及他人看法或先前承诺，只好……

te-mo-sashitsukae-nai.en: it's all right to; there's no problem if

to-atte.en: because (of a special situation); as it is
to-atte.zh: 由于碰上……这种特殊情况

to-areba.en: if it's (for); if (such a special case) is so
to-areba.zh: 如果是……这种情况，或如果是为……

to-ii-to-ii.en: both A and B; in terms of A as well as B
to-ii-to-ii.zh: 无论从甲还是从乙来看，都是……

to-itta-tokoro-da.en: at most; about; more or less
to-itta-tokoro-da.zh: 充其量……、大概在……这个程度

to-kitara.en: when it comes to; as for (complaint)

to-shita-tokoro-de-ni-shita-tokoro-de.en: even if; even supposing; even for (someone)
to-shita-tokoro-de-ni-shita-tokoro-de.zh: 即便假设……也……；即便对某人来说也……

to-mo-naku-to-mo-nashi-ni.en: without meaning to; idly; (with question words) no particular
to-mo-naku-to-mo-nashi-ni.zh: 无意中……、没特意……；与疑问词连用表示不确定

nai-made-mo.en: even if not (to that extent), at least
nai-made-mo.zh: 即使做不到……的程度，至少可以……

nai-mono-de-mo-nai.en: it's not impossible that; might (under some conditions)
nai-mono-de-mo-nai.zh: 并非完全不可能，在特定条件下也许可以

nagara-ni-nagara-no.zh: 保持原状或原有身份、与生俱来

nakushite-wa.zh: 没有……就无法……，强调不可缺少的条件

nara-iza-shirazu-wa-iza-shirazu.en: it may be different for ..., but; I don't know about ..., but

nara-mada-shimo.en: if it were ..., it would be one thing (but)

nari-nari.en: either A or B; A or B or whatever

nari-ni-nari-no.en: in one's own way; as far as (one's limits) allow
nari-ni-nari-no.zh: 按自己的方式或能力所及去做

ni-wa-ataranai.en: there's no need to; it's not worth (being surprised, etc.)

ni-atte.en: in (a situation or position); at (a time)

ni-shite.en: only (at/with); even for; being both A and B
ni-shite.zh: 直到……才、连……也；或同时具备甲和乙

ni-sokushite.en: in accordance with; based on (the facts, actual conditions)
ni-sokushite.zh: 依据实际情况或事实、切合……

ni-taeru-ni-taenai.en: be worth (doing); unbearable to (see, hear); (feel) deeply
ni-taeru-ni-taenai.zh: 值得……；不忍听看，或深切感到……

ni-todomarazu.en: not limited to; not stopping at; going beyond

no-itari.en: utmost; the height of (in set phrases)

ba-sore-made-da.en: if ..., that's the end of it; it's all for nothing if
ba-sore-made-da.zh: 如果……，一切就到此为止或前功尽弃

bekarazu-bekarazaru.en: must not; do not (on signs); (before a noun) must not be
bekarazu-bekarazaru.zh: 严禁……、不得……，常见于告示或书面语

beku-mo-nai.en: cannot possibly; there's no way to

majiki.en: unacceptable for (someone in that position); should not
majiki.zh: 这种身份的人不应有的、不可容忍的

made-mo-nai.en: needless to; there's no need to (go as far as)

made-da-made-no-koto-da.zh: 到时就……而已；或表示所做的仅此而已

mo-saru-koto-nagara.en: not only ... but also (even more); ... aside

mono-o.en: if only (..., but); although (regret or reproach)
mono-o.zh: 要是……就好了却……，带遗憾或责备

ya-ina-ya.en: as soon as; the moment; no sooner ... than

o-oite.en: other than; apart from (no one / nothing else)

o-kawakiri-ni.en: starting with; beginning with (followed by a series)

o-ki-ni.en: taking the opportunity of; with (an event) as a turning point

o-kagiri-ni.en: as of (and no longer); for the last time; at the top of (one's voice)
o-kagiri-ni.zh: 以……为截止、这是最后一次；也可表示用尽全力发声

o-motte.en: with; by means of; as of (a time)
o-motte.zh: 凭借……、通过……；也可表示从某时起生效或截止

o-mono-tomo-sezu.zh: 不畏……、不把困难放在眼里

o-yoso-ni.en: ignoring; paying no heed to; oblivious to

n-ga-tame-ni.en: in order to; for the sake of (strong resolve)
n-ga-tame-ni.zh: 为了……，常带强烈的目的或决心

n-bakari.en: as if about to; almost (to the point of)

dano-dano.en: things like A and B (complaining list)

te-habakaranai.zh: 毫不避讳地做或公开说……

tomo-arou.en: of all people; someone (of such standing) as
tomo-arou.zh: 堂堂……竟然……，常带意外或责备

ni-kakotsukete.en: using (something) as an excuse or pretext

ni-iwasereba.zh: 照某人的说法、在某人看来

ni-kamakete.en: being too wrapped up in (to attend to other things)

kai-mo-naku.zh: 虽付出努力却没有成效

kitte-no.en: the most ... in; the best in

beku-shite.en: as was bound to happen; inevitably
beku-shite.zh: 注定会……，事情按其必然趋势发生

jimiru-jimita.en: smack of; seem like (in a bad way); -ish
jimiru-jimita.zh: 带有……的不良色彩、显得像……

gurumi.zh: 连同整个群体一起、包括……在内

ni-mo-hodo-ga-aru.en: there's a limit to; too ... (beyond what's acceptable)

o-ii-koto-ni.en: taking (unfair) advantage of; using (a situation) as license to
o-ii-koto-ni.zh: 利用……这个便利条件来占便宜或为所欲为

kare-kare.en: whether A or B; A or B alike (fixed pairs)
kare-kare.zh: 无论……还是……，多用于固定搭配

o-fumaete.en: based on; taking into account; in light of

nai-to-mo-kagiranai.en: it's not impossible that; there's a chance that
nai-to-mo-kagiranai.zh: 也有可能……、不能排除这种可能

ni-saishite.en: on the occasion of; when; at the time of

ni-oujite.en: according to; depending on; in response to

ni-hanshite.en: contrary to; against; in violation of

ni-motozuite.en: based on; on the basis of

ni-watatte.en: over; throughout; spanning (a whole period or area)
ni-watatte.zh: 长达……、遍及……，覆盖整个时段或区域

ni-kuwaete.en: in addition to; on top of

o-megutte.en: over; concerning; surrounding (an issue of dispute)
o-megutte.zh: 围绕……，多指有争议的问题

o-tsuujite-o-tooshite.en: through; via; by way of; throughout (a period)
o-tsuujite-o-tooshite.zh: 通过……、经由……；也可表示贯穿整个期间

o-kikkake-ni.en: taking the opportunity of; triggered by; with ... as the start

ka-no-you-da.en: as if; as though (when it isn't really so)
ka-no-you-da.zh: 仿佛……似的，实际并非如此

kanenai.en: could well; might (lead to something bad)
kanenai.zh: 可能会……，通常指不好的结果

kaneru.en: cannot; be unable to (polite refusal); find it hard to
kaneru.zh: 难以……、无法……，常用于委婉拒绝

zu-ni-wa-irarenai.en: can't help doing; can't resist doing
zu-ni-wa-irarenai.zh: 忍不住做……、实在无法克制

zaru-o-enai.en: have no choice but to; cannot help but

te-wa-irarenai.en: can't afford to (keep) doing; can't just

mono-ka.en: no way (will I); as if; I'll never
mono-ka.zh: 怎么会……、绝不会……，表示强烈反问或否定

mono-no.en: although; even though (but the expected result doesn't follow)
mono-no.zh: 虽然……却没有出现预期结果

mono-nara.en: if (it were possible); if only one could
mono-nara.zh: 如果真能……的话；要是能……就好了

kurai-nara-gurai-nara.en: rather than; if it comes to (doing that), I'd rather

mono-ga-aru.en: there is something (about it that is) ...; it really is
mono-ga-aru.zh: 确实有让人感到……的地方

koto-ka.zh: 多么……啊，强调感受或程度

koto-ni-wa.en: (emotion)-ly; what is (surprising, sad, etc.) is that

koto-dakara.zh: 就是因为了解某人，才料想他会……

koto-kara.en: from the fact that; because; judging from
koto-kara.zh: 由于……这一事实，或由此推断……

nai-koto-ni-wa.en: unless; if ... not (then it can't happen)

koto-wa-ga.en: it's true that ..., but; (I) do ..., but

ageku.en: after (a long, troublesome process); in the end

amari-ni.en: so much that; out of excessive; because of too much

ue-ni.en: besides; on top of; in addition to

ue-de.en: after (doing), upon; in (doing), when it comes to
ue-de.zh: 做完……之后再……；也可表示在做……时

ijou-wa.en: since; now that; as long as

kara-ni-wa.en: now that; since (having done/being ..., one must)

kara-koso.en: precisely because; it is because ... that

kara-shite.en: judging from; (starting) even with; to begin with
kara-shite.zh: 单从……就能判断；或光是……就已经……

kara-suru-to-kara-sureba.en: judging from; from the standpoint of
kara-suru-to-kara-sureba.zh: 从……的角度或迹象来判断

kara-miru-to-kara-mireba.en: from the point of view of; judging from; seen from
kara-miru-to-kara-mireba.zh: 站在……的立场来看；从……可以看出

kara-iu-to-kara-itte.en: in terms of; from the standpoint of; judging by

sai-ni.en: when; at the time of; on the occasion of

sue-ni.en: after (a long process of); finally, at the end of
sue-ni.zh: 经过长时间的过程后，最终……

ta-tokoro-de.en: even if (it would be no use); no matter how much

ta-tokoro.en: when (I) did ..., (I found that); upon doing

bakari-ni.en: simply because; just because (with a bad result)
bakari-ni.zh: 就因为……才造成了坏结果

bakari-da.zh: 一直朝同一方向变化，常指进一步恶化

wa-mochiron-wa-motoyori.en: not to mention; of course ... and also

wa-tomokaku.en: setting aside; regardless of; whatever about

hanmen.en: on the other hand; while (it is ...)
hanmen.zh: 另一方面……，表示同一事物的另一面

nagara-mo.zh: 虽然……却……，与通常预期相反

tsutsu-tsutsu-mo.zh: 一边……一边……；也可表示明知如此却……

tsutsu-aru.en: be in the process of; be gradually (changing)
tsutsu-aru.zh: 正在逐渐……、处于变化过程中

ppanashi.en: leaving (something) as is; keep (doing) without a break
ppanashi.zh: 做了之后不管，或一直不停地做

nuku.en: do to the very end; see through; do thoroughly

uru-enai.en: can; be possible / cannot; be impossible

gatai.zh: 很难……，尤其指心理上难以接受或相信

you-ga-nai.en: there's no way to; cannot possibly (no means available)
you-ga-nai.zh: 没有办法……，缺少可用的手段

you-de-wa.en: if (you are like this / keep doing this), (it's no good)
you-de-wa.zh: 如果一直这样……，后果会不妙

ni-kagiru.en: nothing beats; the best thing is

ni-kagitte.en: of all (times/people); precisely when; (someone) of all people wouldn't
ni-kagitte.zh: 偏偏……；也可表示“唯独那个人不会……”

kagiri.en: as long as; as far as (to the limit of)
kagiri.zh: 只要……；也可表示在所知或所能的范围内

ni-kakete-wa.en: when it comes to; in terms of (skill)

ni-kotaete.zh: 回应……、满足……的期望或请求

ni-shiro-ni-seyo.en: even if; whether ... or ...; in any case
ni-shiro-ni-seyo.zh: 即使……；也可表示不论是……还是……

ni-sureba-ni-shitara.en: from the standpoint of; for (someone), (it would seem)

ni-koshita-koto-wa-nai.en: it's best to; nothing is better than

ni-hoka-naranai.en: nothing other than; none other than; precisely

ni-atatte.en: when; at the time of; on the occasion of (starting something important)
ni-atatte.zh: 在开始重要事项之际、值此……

ni-oite-ni-okeru.en: in; at; in the field of (formal)

ni-kakawaru.zh: 关系到……、影响到重要事物

ni-tsuki.en: per; for each; due to (in formal notices)
ni-tsuki.zh: 每……、按每……计算；正式通知中也可表示“由于……”

ni-mukete.en: toward; aimed at; in preparation for; addressed to

no-moto-de-no-moto-ni.zh: 在……的指导、影响或规则之下

o-komete.zh: 带着……的感情，或把感情倾注其中

o-moto-ni.en: based on; using ... as a basis or source

o-hajime.en: starting with; including; such as (a representative example)
o-hajime.zh: 以……为代表，连同其他同类事物

o-to-shite.en: treating (A) as (B); with A as B

ka-to-iu-to.en: if you ask whether (actually, not); the reason why ... is
ka-to-iu-to.zh: 要说是否……；也可引出对“为什么”的解释

ka-to-omottara-ka-to-omou-to.en: just when; no sooner than; the moment

kiri.zh: 自从……后就没有再……；也可表示“仅仅”

ge.en: seeming; looking (as if); with an air of

kko-nai.en: no way; there's absolutely no chance

dokoro-ka.en: far from; let alone; on the contrary
dokoro-ka.zh: 别说……，反倒……；也可表示甚至超过预期

dokoro-de-wa-nai.en: this is no time for; out of the question
dokoro-de-wa-nai.zh: 哪里顾得上……、根本谈不上……

to-iu-mono-da.en: that's what (A) is; that's just how it is; that's really
to-iu-mono-da.zh: 这才叫……、本来就是这么回事

to-iu-mono-de-wa-nai.en: it's not (necessarily) the case that; it doesn't follow that
to-iu-mono-de-wa-nai.zh: 不能一概认为……、并不是说……就……

to-itte-mo.en: although I say; even though (it's called)
to-itte-mo.zh: 虽说是……，但实际程度或情况有别

to-ieba-to-iu-to.en: speaking of; when you think of; if you mention

hoka-nai.en: have no choice but to; there's nothing to do but

mai.zh: 决不……；也可表示推测，大概不会……

you-de-wa-nai-ka.en: let's (formal call to action); why don't we
you-de-wa-nai-ka.zh: 让我们……吧，用于较正式的倡议

mo-kamawazu.en: without caring about; regardless of; paying no attention to

jou.en: from the standpoint of; in terms of; for reasons of
jou.zh: 从……角度看、由于……方面的原因

osore-ga-aru.en: there is a risk that; could (bad outcome)
osore-ga-aru.zh: 有发生坏结果的可能、恐怕会……

dake-atte-dake-ni.en: as might be expected (since); precisely because; all the more because
dake-atte-dake-ni.zh: 不愧是……；也可表示正因为……才更……

dake-no-koto-wa-aru.en: it's no wonder; it lives up to; as expected of

yara-yara.en: what with ... and ...; and ... and (among other things)
yara-yara.zh: 又是……又是……，列举多种情况

zu-ni-sumu-naide-sumu.en: get by without; not have to; be spared from
zu-ni-sumu-naide-sumu.zh: 不用做……就能解决或过关

wake-da.en: no wonder; that's why; it follows that
wake-da.zh: 原来如此、难怪；由此可知……

wake-de-wa-nai.en: it doesn't mean that; it's not that; not necessarily

wake-ga-nai.en: there's no way that; cannot possibly

wake-ni-wa-ikanai.en: can't afford to; can't very well; must not (for social or moral reasons)
wake-ni-wa-ikanai.zh: 碍于情理、责任等不能做某事

mono-da.en: it's natural that; one should; used to (nostalgia); how ...! (deep feeling)
mono-da.zh: 本来就会……、理应……；也可表示怀念或感叹

mono-de-wa-nai.en: one shouldn't; it's not right to

mono-mon.zh: 因为嘛，口语中用于辩解

mono-dakara-mono-de.en: because; since (explaining or excusing a situation)
mono-dakara-mono-de.zh: 因为……，多用于说明缘由或辩解

koto-da.en: should; the best thing is to (advice)

koto-wa-nai.en: there's no need to; don't have to

koto-ni-shite-iru.en: make it a rule to; make a point of
koto-ni-shite-iru.zh: 自己规定要……，并一直照做

koto-ni-natte-iru.en: it has been arranged that; it's the rule that; be supposed to
koto-ni-natte-iru.zh: 按规定或事先安排应当……

koto-instruction.zh: 必须……，多见于书面规定或指令

you-ni-iu-you-ni-tanomu.en: tell someone to do; ask someone to do (reported command or request)
you-ni-iu-you-ni-tanomu.zh: 转述命令或请求，即“叫某人……、请某人……”

you-to-suru.en: try to; attempt to; be about to

sou-ni-nai-sou-mo-nai.en: unlikely to; doesn't look like it will

ippou-da.en: keep on -ing; more and more (change in one direction)
ippou-da.zh: 不断……、越来越……，变化朝一个方向发展

ippou-de.en: while; on the other hand; at the same time
ippou-de.zh: 一方面……另一方面……；也可表示同时进行

ni-taishite.zh: 对、针对；也可表示与另一方形成对照

ni-yotte-ni-yoru.en: by (agent); by means of; due to; depending on

mo-ba-mo.en: both ... and ...; not only ... but also

rashii-typical-of.zh: 具有……典型特征，像个真正的……

ppoi.zh: 有点像……、带有……特征，或容易……

teki.zh: 表示性质、倾向或看问题的角度

ni-kimatte-iru.en: certainly; is bound to; of course

ki-ga-suru.en: have a feeling that; feel like

mama.en: as it is; unchanged; while still (in a state)
mama.zh: 保持原样、在某状态下就……

uchi-ni.en: while (before it changes); before it's too late; in the course of
uchi-ni.zh: 趁……还没变；也可表示在……过程中

tokoro-ni-tokoro-e-tokoro-o.en: just when; at the moment (someone arrives or something interrupts)
tokoro-ni-tokoro-e-tokoro-o.zh: 正在……的时候碰巧遇到某事，或被打断

hodo.en: to the extent that; so ... that

kurai-gurai-extent.en: to the extent that; so ... that; at least (something minimal)
kurai-gurai-extent.zh: ……到……的程度；也可表示最低限度

sae-ba.en: if only; as long as; provided that

to-shite.en: as; in the role or capacity of

ni-totte.zh: 对……而言，从某人的立场看

ni-shite-wa.zh: 按……来说却……，结果与预期不同

ni-shite-mo.en: even if; even considering; granted that

ni-kawatte.en: instead of; on behalf of; replacing

kawari-ni.en: instead of; in exchange for; to make up for

ni-tsurete.en: as (one thing changes, another changes too)

to-tomo-ni.en: together with; along with; as; at the same time as

saichuu-ni.en: right in the middle of; while (busy with)
saichuu-ni.zh: 正处于……之中，正在做某事时

tsuide-ni.en: while (at it); on the occasion of; since one is doing it anyway

sei-de.en: because of; due to (bad result, blame)

ta-totan-ta-totan-ni.en: the moment; just as (something unexpected happens)

tara-ta.en: when I did A, (I found that) B; upon doing, I discovered
tara-ta.zh: 做了某事后，发现了出乎意料的情况

nai-koto-wa-nai.en: it's not that ... not; can if necessary; not impossible
nai-koto-wa-nai.zh: 也不是不……；必要的话可以……

te-bakari-iru.en: do nothing but; keep on doing (critical)
te-bakari-iru.zh: 老是做同一件事，常带批评

ba-ii.en: should; all you need to do is; I hope (with のに/けど: I wish)
ba-ii.zh: 只要……就行；也可表示建议或愿望

baai-wa.en: in the case of; if; in the event that

tte.en: (casual quotation) says that; I heard; as for; what is
tte.zh: 口语引用或转述；也可提示话题或追问含义

to-iu-koto-da.en: I heard that; it means that; in other words

to-iu-no-wa.en: what is meant by ... is; ... means; the reason is
to-iu-no-wa.zh: 所谓……是指……；也可解释原因

to-iu-yori.en: rather than; not so much A as B
to-iu-yori.zh: 与其说是甲，不如说是乙

wari-ni-wari-ni-wa.zh: 照……来说，结果却比预想的……

kara-ni-kakete.en: from ... through; over (a period or area)
kara-ni-kakete.zh: 从……到……，表示大致的时间或空间范围

buri.en: for the first time in (a period); manner, way of doing
buri.zh: 时隔……再次；也可表示做事的样子或方式

kke.en: was it?; did I?; (trying to recall)

muki-muke.en: suitable for / aimed at; intended for

gachi.en: tend to; be prone to; often

gimi.en: a touch of; slightly; somewhat (in that condition)

darake.en: full of; covered with; riddled with

kiru-kirenai.en: do completely; finish / can't finish; too many to
kiru-kirenai.zh: 彻底做完；或多到无法做完

kakeru.en: half-done; start to; be about to
kakeru.zh: 做了一半、刚开始做或差点发生

au.en: do to each other; do together

naosu.en: redo; do over again (to fix or improve)

zurai.en: hard to; difficult or uncomfortable to
zurai.zh: 做起来有困难或不舒服

hodo-wa-nai.en: nothing is as ... as; there's no ... like

shika-nai-no-choice.en: have no choice but to; can only

tokoro-datta.zh: 差一点就……，实际上没有发生

kara-to-itte.en: just because (... doesn't mean); simply because

toori-ni-doori-ni.en: as; in the way that; exactly as

nanka-nante.en: things like; the likes of (dismissive or humble); how ...! (surprise)
nanka-nante.zh: ……之类的，可表示轻视或自谦；也可表达惊讶

ageru-kureru-morau.en: give (to someone else); give (to me or my group); receive
ageru-kureru-morau.zh: 给别人、别人给我方、从别人那里得到

te-ageru.en: do something for someone (as a favor)

te-kureru.en: someone does something for me (or my group)

te-morau.en: have someone do something (for me); get someone to do
te-morau.zh: 请别人为我方做某事，或得到对方的帮助

te-kudasaru-te-itadaku.en: (honorific) someone kindly does for me; (humble) I receive the favor of someone doing
te-kudasaru-te-itadaku.zh: 对方为我方做某事的尊敬说法；我方承蒙对方做某事的谦逊说法

te-iku.en: do something and go; go on doing (from now into the future)
te-iku.zh: 做完再离开；也表示动作或变化从现在延续到将来

te-kuru.en: do something and come back; come doing; (change) up to now; start to
te-kuru.zh: 做了再来、朝这边做；也表示变化发展到现在或开始出现

te-shimau-chau.en: finish completely; do by accident; end up doing (with regret)
te-shimau-chau.zh: 做完、做尽；也可表示不慎做了或说话人感到遗憾

te-oku.en: do in advance (to prepare); do and leave as is
te-oku.zh: 事先做好准备；做完后保持原状

te-miru.en: try doing (to see what it is like)

te-aru.en: has been done (and stays that way); resulting state of a deliberate action
te-aru.zh: 有意做成某状态，而且状态仍然保持

aida-aida-ni.en: while; during (the whole time); at some point during
aida-aida-ni.zh: 在整个期间……；在期间内的某个时候……

sou-da-appearance.en: looks like; seems; looks about to

sou-da-hearsay.en: I heard that; they say that

rashii.zh: 据说……、好像……，常根据听闻或间接信息

you-da.en: it seems; it appears (judging from evidence)

chuu-juu.en: in the middle of; during (ちゅう); throughout; all over (じゅう)
chuu-juu.zh: 正在……期间；也可表示整个范围都……

koto-ni-naru.en: it has been decided that; it turns out that
koto-ni-naru.zh: 已经决定……；也可表示结果成了这样

koto-ga-dekiru.en: can; be able to; be possible to

eru-rareru-potential.zh: 动词的可能形，表示能做某事

reru-rareru-passive.zh: 动词的被动形，表示动作由别人施加

seru-saseru.en: make someone do; let someone do (causative)
seru-saseru.zh: 让、叫或允许某人做某事

serareru-saserareru.en: be made to do (against one's will)

ou-you.zh: 一起做吧；也可表示说话人的意志

you-to-omou.en: be thinking of doing; plan to

nasai.en: do (instruction from a parent, teacher, etc.)
nasai.zh: 请做……，多用于长辈或老师向晚辈提出要求

tara.zh: 如果……；也可表示做完之后

nara.en: if (it's the case that); if you're talking about
nara.zh: 如果是……的话；要是说的是……

to.en: when; if; whenever (natural or automatic result)
to.zh: 一……就……，常表示自然或规律性的结果

noni-although.en: although; even though (with surprise or dissatisfaction)
noni-although.zh: 虽然……却……，常带意外或不满

noni-purpose.en: for; in order to (with use, time or cost)
noni-purpose.zh: 用于……、做……需要多少时间或费用

te-reason.en: because; so (cause of a feeling or state)
te-reason.zh: 表示感受或状态出现的原因

shi.en: and what's more; and besides (listing reasons)
shi.zh: 而且……；可以列举多个理由

kedo-keredomo.zh: 虽然……但是……；也可委婉引出话题

tame-ni.en: in order to; for (the sake of); because of

you-ni-suru.en: try to; make sure to; make a habit of
you-ni-suru.zh: 尽量做到……，或有意识地养成习惯

you-ni-naru.en: come to; reach the point where (change in ability or habit)
you-ni-naru.zh: 逐渐能……、变得会……或开始有某种习惯

garu.en: (someone else) feels; shows signs of feeling
garu.zh: 表现出某种感受，用于描述他人

darou.en: probably; I suppose (plain form of でしょう)
darou.zh: 大概……，是でしょう的简体

hazu-da.en: should be; is expected to (based on reasoning)

hazu-ga-nai.en: can't be; there's no way that

n-desu-no-desu.en: it's that ...; (explaining or asking for an explanation)
n-desu-no-desu.zh: 用来解释情况，或请对方说明原因

ka-embedded-question.zh: 把“什么、哪里、谁”等疑问嵌入句中

tokoro-da.en: be about to; be in the middle of; have just done
tokoro-da.zh: 正要做、正在做或刚做完

hajimeru-owaru-tsuzukeru.en: start doing; finish doing; keep doing

nakanaka-nai.en: not easily; just won't; not readily

zutsu.en: each; at a time; little by little

mo-emphasis.en: as many as; as much as; (with a negative) not even one
mo-emphasis.zh: 竟有这么多；与否定连用可表示“连一个也没有”

made-ni.zh: 在……之前完成，以该时间为期限

sonkeigo.en: honorific verbs; respectful language for others' actions
sonkeigo.zh: 尊敬语，用来抬高对方或第三者的动作

kenjougo.en: humble verbs; modest language for one's own actions
kenjougo.zh: 谦让语，用于谦称己方的动作

o-ni-naru.zh: 尊敬表达，用于长辈、客人等人的动作

o-suru.zh: 谦让表达，用于己方为对方所做的动作

de-gozaimasu.zh: 十分礼貌的判断表达，相当于“是……”

te-mo-kamawanai.en: don't mind if; it's fine if

no-koto-nominalizer.en: the act of doing (turns a verb phrase into a noun)

ba-yokatta.en: should have (done); I wish I had

toka-toka.en: things like A and B; A, B and so on (casual)

nado.en: etc.; and so on; such as

sa.en: -ness (turns an adjective into a noun of degree)
sa.zh: 把形容词变成表示性质或程度的名词

ku-suru-ni-suru.en: make (something) ...; change something to a state
ku-suru-ni-suru.zh: 把某事物变成某种状态

ga-suru.en: (a smell, sound, taste or feeling) is perceived
ga-suru.zh: 感觉到某种气味、声音、味道或感受

kana-kashira.zh: 不知道……呢，表示自问或揣测

te-kuremasen-ka-te-itadakemasen-ka.zh: 能不能请您……？礼貌地请求对方做某事

naide.zh: 没有做……就做了另一件事，或用后者代替前者

wa.en: as for; marks the topic of the sentence

ga-subject.en: marks the subject; points out new or focused information
ga-subject.zh: 标记主语，引出新信息或焦点

o.en: marks the direct object of a verb; marks a place moved through or left
o.zh: 标记宾语，或经过、离开的地点

ni-time.en: at; on; in (a specific point in time)

ni-destination.zh: 到某处，表示移动的目的地

ni-location.en: in; at; on (where someone or something is)
ni-location.zh: 在某处，表示人或事物存在的位置

ni-indirect-object.en: to (the person who receives or is the target of an action)
ni-indirect-object.zh: 给、向，表示动作的接受者或对象

ni-frequency.en: per; in (how many times within a period)

de-place.en: at; in (the place where an action happens)

de-means.en: by; with; in (means, tool, method or language)
de-means.zh: 用、通过，表示工具、方式或语言

to-and.en: and (joining nouns in a complete list)

to-with.en: with; together with (a partner in an action)

ya.en: and (giving some examples out of more); ... and so on
ya.zh: 列举部分事例，意为“……之类”

mo.en: also; too; (with a negative) not ... either; neither ... nor
mo.zh: 也；与否定搭配表示“也不”

kara-from.en: from (a starting point in time or place)
kara-from.zh: 从，表示时间或地点的起点

made.en: until; up to; as far as

ka-question.en: (question marker) turns a sentence into a question

ne.en: isn't it?; right? (seeking agreement or sharing a feeling)
ne.zh: 征求认同或分享感受，相当于“吧、呢”

yo.en: you know; I tell you (giving new information or emphasis)
yo.zh: 告知新信息或加强语气

to-to-dochira-ga.en: which is more ..., X or Y?

de-wa-arimasen-ja-nai.en: is not; am not; are not
de-wa-arimasen-ja-nai.zh: 不是，分别为礼貌体和简体

deshita.zh: 礼貌体判断句的过去式

masu.en: polite non-past verb ending (do; will do)
masu.zh: 动词礼貌体的非过去式

masen.zh: 动词礼貌体的非过去否定式

masen-deshita.zh: 动词礼貌体的过去否定式

nai.en: do not; will not (plain negative of verbs)
nai.zh: 动词简体的非过去否定式

ta.zh: 动词简体的过去式，也可表示完成

mashou-ka.zh: 要不要一起做，或“我来做吧？”

masen-ka.en: won't you ...?; would you like to ...? (polite invitation)
masen-ka.zh: 礼貌地邀请对方做某事

o-kudasai.zh: 请给我某物；点单时表示“我要……”

te-iru.en: be doing (ongoing action); be in a state (result of a change); do regularly
te-iru.zh: 正在做、动作后的状态或经常做

te.en: and; and then (linking actions in order)
te.zh: 连接动作，可表示先后顺序

te-kara.en: after doing; (do A) and then (B); since
te-kara.zh: 做了某事之后；自从做了某事

tari-tari-suru.en: do things like A and B; sometimes A, sometimes B
tari-tari-suru.zh: 做做这个、做做那个；有时做这个、有时做那个

ta-koto-ga-aru.en: have (ever) done; have the experience of doing

nagara.en: while (doing two actions at the same time)
nagara.zh: 一边做某事，一边做另一件事

ga-aru-ga-iru.en: there is; there are; have (ある for things, いる for people and animals)
ga-aru-ga-iru.zh: 有……；ある用于事物，いる用于人和动物

deshou.zh: 大概……；也可向对方确认“……吧？”

mou-ta.zh: 已经做了……；疑问句中问“……了吗？”

amari-nai.en: not very; not much; not often

zenzen-nai.en: not at all; not in the least

kurai-gurai.en: about; approximately (an amount or length of time)

nani-mo-nai-dare-mo-nai.en: nothing; nobody; not anything; not anyone

nani-ka-dare-ka-doko-ka.zh: 某件东西、某个人、某个地方

kore-sore-are-dore.en: this one; that one (near you); that one (over there); which one
kore-sore-are-dore.zh: 这个、那个（靠近听话人）、那个（离双方远）、哪个

kono-sono-ano-dono.en: this; that (near you); that ... over there; which (before a noun)
kono-sono-ano-dono.zh: 这个、那个、那个、哪个，后面要接名词

koko-soko-asoko-doko.en: here; there (near you); over there; where
koko-soko-asoko-doko.zh: 这里、那里（靠近听话人）、那里（离双方远）、哪里

ku-nai-katta-ku-nakatta.en: negative and past forms of i-adjectives (is not; was; was not)
ku-nai-katta-ku-nakatta.zh: い形容词的否定、过去和过去否定形式

na-na-adjective.en: na-adjectives: take な before a noun and です or だ at the end of a sentence
na-na-adjective.zh: な形容词修饰名词时接な，句末可用だ或です

kute-de.zh: 连接形容词或名词，表示并列
